parameters.name: AddonName
parameters.description: The name of the add-on. If you assign a value to AddonName, the ReleaseName parameter is ignored and all AddonReleases that belong to the same add-on are deleted.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description: Whether to be forcibly deleted. The default value is false.
